author: @minh.nguyen
_comment: FX-normalized MFN / fee-tier evaluator. v1 (inherited from USD-only funds) compared commitment.amount raw against USD thresholds, so EUR/GBP/AUD LPs got the wrong tier in UAT on 2026-01-20. Every threshold now runs on the USD Equivalent at the rate the side-letter policy pins (Annex C Section 2.3), stored with the subscription. To reuse: copy and change PARAMETERS only. Rate source, fixing rule, rounding and tiers come from the new fund's side-letter policy, never from our market-data feed. If the policy is silent, get counsel to specify before UAT. -- Minh

parameters.rateSource: WM/Refinitiv 4:00 p.m. London closing spot, mid (Annex C Section 2.3(b))
parameters._comment: Thresholds are inclusive and tested on the ROUNDED USD amount. UAT fixing 2026-01-19: EUR/USD 1.1650, GBP/USD 1.3420, AUD/USD 0.6680. Fixing date is taken on the London calendar: a 06:00 ICT submission is still the previous day in London.

validation.message: Commitment must be greater than zero.

fields.label: Affiliated Investor Group (Annex C Section 1.3)
fields._comment: Set by the admin once the GP accepts the affiliation evidence. Groups span BOTH feeders.

fields.label: Reference Rate applied (USD per 1 unit)
fields._comment: Stored exactly as published. Never re-derive it from usd_equivalent / amount.

fields.label: USD Equivalent
fields._comment: USD commitments still get rate 1.0000 and a fixing date, so every subscription carries the same audit trail.

fields.label: Aggregate Commitment (USD Equivalent)
fields._comment: affiliates = other subscriptions with the same affiliated_group_id, both feeders. Convert each at ITS OWN fixing, then add. Never sum raw amounts across currencies.

rules._comment: Written once, at submission (Section 2.3(g)); the admin ties out against this. Re-opening the form must never re-price it.
THE v1 BUG lived here: it tested commitment.amount. Thresholds only ever see USD Equivalents.
Electable clauses = matrix rows with mfn_electable == 'yes' && min_tier <= mfn.tier (Sections 1.2, 4.3).
An over-tiered LP must never receive the compendium. Confidentiality, not just fees.
Increase converts at its own fixing (same rule, on amendment.submitted_at) and is persisted like fx.lock_on_submit. Original tranche is never restated (2.3(e)).
Section 2.3(f): only a reduction or transfer can move an LP down.
